newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Gulf Arab states to offer projects worth $140 mln.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Arab states to offer projects worth $140 mln.

text.p: The secretary-general of the Gulf Organisation for Industrial Consulting (GOIC) said on Monday the group would offer 17 new projects in the Gulf worth $140 million to potential investors.
GOIC is part of the Gulf Cooperation Council, which is a political and economic alliance of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and the United Arab Emirates.
The Gulf News Agency quoted Abdul-Rahman al-Jaafari as saying eight projects worth $47.7 million in the engineering sector would be offered at a seminar which starts in Bahrain on Tuesday.
Four projects requiring investment of $62 million in the metals sector and two petrochemical projects worth $15.3 million would be showcased.
One project in plastics worth $10.4 million and two worth $4 million in the food sector would also be offered, he said.
